fichas.title: Bus station layouts and vehicle parking
fichas.summary: Illustrated arrangements for bus and articulated-bus parking, drive-through bus stations, separate arrival and departure platforms, angled platforms, and alternative vehicle circulation layouts. Figure 9 shows a drive-through station with separate arrival and departure platforms, an oblique layout, and distant parking.

fichas.title: KLM bus station: ground floor and basement
fichas.summary: Ground-floor and basement plans for a bus station, with passenger entrances and exits, a concourse, baggage handling and storage, ticketing and information, waiting room, staff facilities, and service rooms. The basement plan is referenced to the ground-floor plan.
